verdict.rationale: BVNK documents an API-driven fiat-to-crypto onramp (linking a fiat virtual account funded via bank transfer to a blockchain address, docs-5/23/14) and 'Embedded Wallets' that let partners offer payment/fund management inside their own branded platform (docs-8, docs-15), which covers bank-transfer-based onramp and embeddability. However there is no documented card-based purchase flow or a pre-built checkout/onramp widget UI for end users to 'buy stablecoins with cards' — missing for 10: card-payment onramp widget/checkout UI, explicit end-user 'buy stablecoin' flow, evidence of a drop-in embeddable onramp component.
